title: The seven gifts of the Holy Ghost
html_source:
The Seven gifts of the Holy Ghost are said to be received when one fully devotes himself to the church, which Stephen tries to do. They are, according to Isaiah 11:2
wisdom, understanding, counsel, fortitude, knowledge, piety, and fear of the Lord
